research.basedefense.farmer_house.desc: A small house with a garden yard. The builder builds it from your materials, then a farmer moves in and puts the harvest into the house chest.
message.basedefense.research.done: %s researched "%s"! The building is now available in the Building Tablet.
research.basedefense.rancher_house.desc: A long barn-like house with an animal pen. The builder builds it, then a rancher moves in.
message.basedefense.base.already_exists: The server already has a Base (%s, %s, %s). You can't place a second one.
screen.basedefense.needs.deposit_hint: Put food here — it goes to the settlement's food supply. Settlers eat every dawn.
message.basedefense.settlement.frozen: The settlement ran out of food — settlers froze! Put food into the Base.
message.basedefense.settlement.unfrozen: Supplies restored — settlers are back to work!
message.basedefense.settlement.low: Settlement food is low: %s. At -20 settlers will freeze.
screen.basedefense.settler.status.frozen: Settlement is out of supplies — idle
screen.basedefense.settler.tip.upgrade: More loot, but more food per day
research.basedefense.cook_house.desc: A tall house with a brick oven, chimney and summer kitchen. The builder builds it, then a cook moves in.
research.basedefense.miner_house.desc: A small house with a mine entrance right in the yard. The builder builds it, then a miner moves in.
research.basedefense.blacksmith_house.de: A wide smithy with a stone chimney and a forge in the yard. The builder builds it, then a blacksmith moves in.
screen.basedefense.settler.tip.ingredien: Hold food and click — it turns into ingredient points (bread = 10)
One day of cooking uses %s points
research.basedefense.lumberjack_house.de: A narrow house with a long tree yard. The builder builds it, then a lumberjack moves in.
research.basedefense.farmer_house.work:
Farmer: tends the garden.
Works on his own and puts everything into the house chest. Every dawn — 3 random finds:
Lvl 1: bread ×1, beetroot ×3, potato ×2, carrot ×3, melon ×3, coins ×3
Lvl 2: bread ×1, beetroot ×5, potato ×4, carrot ×5, melon ×6, coins ×6
Lvl 3: bread ×2, beetroot ×8, potato ×6, carrot ×7, melon ×9, coins ×10
Food per day: 12 / 16 / 23
Upgrades: 20 and 60 coins
research.basedefense.rancher_house.work:
Rancher: looks after the pen.
Works on his own and puts everything into the house chest. Every dawn — 3 random finds:
Lvl 1: beef, pork, mutton or chicken ×2, eggs ×3, leather ×2, wool ×3, coins ×3
Lvl 2: meat ×3, eggs ×6, leather ×3, wool ×5, coins ×6
Lvl 3: meat ×5, eggs ×10, leather ×5, wool ×8, coins ×10
Food per day: 13 / 18 / 25
Upgrades: 20 and 60 coins
research.basedefense.cook_house.work:
Cook: give him food from your hand — it becomes ingredient points (bread = 10). With 30 points he cooks one dish per day into the house chest:
Lvl 1: pumpkin pie 2–3, cake 1–2, beetroot soup 2–3 or bread 3–4
Lvl 2: pie 3–4, cake 2–3, soup 3–5, bread 4–6 or coins ×10
Lvl 3: same, but coins ×15
Food per day: 12 / 16 / 23
Upgrades: 20 and 60 coins
research.basedefense.miner_house.work:
Miner: works at the bottom of the mine.
Works on his own and puts everything into the house chest. Every dawn — 2 random finds:
Lvl 1: iron ore 4–5, gold ore 2–3, copper ore 8–10, coal 9–12
Lvl 2: iron ore 6–7, gold ore 4–5, coal 15–18, diamond ×1, coins ×10
Lvl 3: iron ore 10–14, gold ore 6–8, coal 20–22, diamonds ×2, coins ×13
Food per day: 13 / 18 / 25
Upgrades: 20 and 60 coins
research.basedefense.blacksmith_house.wo:
The blacksmith's work comes later. For now he just lives in the settlement.
Food per day: 6
research.basedefense.lumberjack_house.wo:
Lumberjack: chops trees on the plot.
Works on his own and puts everything into the house chest. Every dawn — logs of one random kind:
Lvl 1: 16 logs
Lvl 2: 25 logs
Lvl 3: 35 logs and 6 coins
Food per day: 12 / 16 / 23
Upgrades: 20 and 60 coins
research.basedefense.builder_house.desc: The first house of the settlement: it builds itself in seconds. A builder moves in and builds all other houses. Put building materials into the chests of his house.
research.basedefense.builder_house.work:
Builder: builds houses from blueprints.
Choose a house in the Building Tablet and place it — a construction site appears. Right-click it to see the needed blocks.
Put materials into the chests of the builder's house (there are 6), he takes them himself.
Farmer's house build time: 4 min (lvl 1), 3 min (lvl 2), 1.5 min (lvl 3); bigger houses take longer.
Food per day: 12 / 16 / 23
Upgrades: 20 and 60 coins
message.basedefense.house.site_created: Construction site ready! Put materials into the builder's house chests — he will come and build. Right-click the block for the material list.
message.basedefense.house.no_builder: Construction site ready, but there is no builder. Place a Builder's House with the tablet first.
screen.basedefense.house.status.no_build: No builder in the settlement — place a Builder's House
screen.basedefense.house.status.walking: The builder is on his way
screen.basedefense.settler.build.idle: No orders — place a house or square block
research.basedefense.town_square.desc: A 15×15 paved square with a bell tower, benches, lanterns, flower beds and four market stalls under striped awnings. The builder builds it. Settlers sometimes come here to rest and browse the stalls, and the idle builder lays paths from the square to every house.
research.basedefense.town_square.work:
The town square is the heart of the settlement.
During the day settlers sometimes come here to stand by the bell tower or the market stalls (their loot is not reduced).
The stalls are places for future trading.
An idle builder lays paths: a ring around the square, straight main roads and branches to house doors.
Materials: stone bricks, polished andesite, cobblestone, spruce, benches, lanterns, wool, barrels, flowers. The bell is free.
